name: workflow_run
description:
Execute a workflow in a new isolated session and return the session ID immediately. Execution continues in the background — the caller does not wait for completion.

The workflow runner walks the node graph in topological order:
  • parameters nodes  — map the input object onto named workflow parameters (accessible as $input.<name>)
  • prompt nodes      — send the node's instructions to the session agent and capture its reply
  • tool nodes        — call the specified tool with resolved arguments
  • decide nodes      — ask the agent to choose a branch (agent mode) or evaluate a condition (deterministic mode)

The `input` object must match the names declared in the workflow's parameters node.
For example, if the workflow has workflowParameters [{"name": "topic"}], pass {"topic": "climate change"}.

If the workflow has no parameters node, pass an empty object {}.

To inspect the result, use session_get with the returned session ID once execution completes.

workflowId.description: ID of the workflow to run (use workflow_list to see available IDs)

input.description: Input values for the workflow's parameters node, keyed by parameter name. Pass {} if the workflow has no parameters node.

agentId.description: Agent to use for the workflow session. Defaults to the calling agent. Optional.
